sql: SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2024-10-01' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS delivered_rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.delivered_rev, 0) - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT name FROM (SELECT c.name AS name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) DESC, c.name) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY c.id) WHERE rn = 2

SELECT c.segment FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) DESC, c.segment LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(r.rev, 0) - COALESCE(f.ref, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) r ON r.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.employee_id = e.id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH t AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS hrs FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(hrs) AS a FROM t), oc AS (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), ca AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(hrs) AS h FROM t GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ca JOIN oc ON oc.customer_id = ca.customer_id CROSS JOIN avg_all WHERE ca.h > avg_all.a

WITH closed AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS hrs FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs FROM closed), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(hrs) AS a FROM closed GROUP BY customer_id), multi AS (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 2) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg ca CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ca.a > o.avg_hrs AND ca.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM multi)

WITH rev AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS gross FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS refunds FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-03-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.gross, 0) - COALESCE(ref.refunds, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM rev LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = rev.employee_id JOIN employees e ON e.id = rev.employee_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH shipped_items AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id) GROUP BY ym), ret AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' GROUP BY ym) SELECT si.ym AS order_month FROM shipped_items si LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.ym = si.ym ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(r.n,0) AS REAL) / si.n DESC, si.ym LIMIT 1

SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(d.rev, 0) - COALESCE(f.ref, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) d ON d.eid = e.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.employee_id AS eid, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY o.employee_id) f ON f.eid = e.id WHERE d.rev IS NOT NULL ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH d AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id), r AS (SELECT o.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS ref FROM returns rt JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY o.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(d.rev - COALESCE(r.ref, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM d JOIN employees e ON e.id = d.employee_id LEFT JOIN r ON r.employee_id = d.employee_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH t AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS hrs FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(hrs) AS a FROM t), cust_avg AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(hrs) AS ca FROM t GROUP BY customer_id), big AS (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id) >= 4) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust_avg JOIN big ON big.customer_id = cust_avg.customer_id CROSS JOIN avg_all WHERE cust_avg.ca > avg_all.a

WITH shipped_items AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS ym, oi.id AS oi_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id)), ret AS (SELECT si.ym, COUNT(rt.id) AS r FROM shipped_items si JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = si.oi_id GROUP BY si.ym), den AS (SELECT ym, COUNT(*) AS d FROM shipped_items GROUP BY ym) SELECT den.ym FROM den LEFT JOIN ret ON ret.ym = den.ym ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(ret.r, 0) AS REAL) / den.d DESC, den.ym LIMIT 1

WITH d AS (SELECT o.id, o.employee_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'), rev AS (SELECT d.employee_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS r FROM d JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = d.id GROUP BY d.employee_id), ref AS (SELECT d.employee_id, SUM(rt.refund_amount) AS f FROM d JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = d.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id GROUP BY d.employee_id) SELECT e.name, ROUND(COALESCE(rev.r, 0) - COALESCE(ref.f, 0), 2) AS net_revenue FROM employees e LEFT JOIN rev ON rev.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.employee_id = e.id WHERE rev.r IS NOT NULL ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

WITH shipped AS (SELECT o.id, substr(o.order_date,1,7) AS ym FROM orders o WHERE substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2024' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id)), item_counts AS (SELECT sh.ym, COUNT(oi.id) AS items FROM shipped sh JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = sh.id GROUP BY sh.ym), ret_counts AS (SELECT sh.ym, COUNT(rt.id) AS rets FROM shipped sh JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = sh.id JOIN returns rt ON rt.order_item_id = oi.id GROUP BY sh.ym) SELECT ic.ym AS order_month FROM item_counts ic LEFT JOIN ret_counts rc ON rc.ym = ic.ym ORDER BY CAST(COALESCE(rc.rets, 0) AS REAL) / ic.items DESC, ic.ym LIMIT 1

WITH closed AS (SELECT customer_id, (julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24 AS hrs FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs FROM closed), cust AS (SELECT customer_id, AVG(hrs) AS cust_avg FROM closed GROUP BY customer_id), ord AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM cust c JOIN ord o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id CROSS JOIN overall v WHERE c.cust_avg > v.avg_hrs AND o.n >= 8

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id, r.name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2025' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4)='2024' THEN oi.quantity*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount_pct/100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS r24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') AND CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) <= 6 GROUP BY r.id, r.name) SELECT name FROM rev WHERE r24 > 0 ORDER BY (r25 - r24) * 1.0 / r24 DESC, name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-07-01'

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS name, substr(o.order_date,1,4) AS yr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') AND CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 GROUP BY r.id, yr) SELECT a.name FROM rev a JOIN rev b ON b.region_id = a.region_id AND b.yr = '2024' WHERE a.yr = '2025' AND b.rev > 0 ORDER BY (a.rev - b.rev) / b.rev ASC LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS id, r.name AS name, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS y, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) IN ('2024', '2025') GROUP BY r.id, y) SELECT a.name FROM rev a JOIN rev b ON a.id = b.id AND a.y = '2025' AND b.y = '2024' WHERE b.amt <> 0 ORDER BY (a.amt - b.amt) / b.amt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers cu ON cu.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = cu.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Hail' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-09-30'

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS rid, r.name AS name, substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) AS yr, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS rev FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) IN ('2024', '2025') GROUP BY r.id, yr) SELECT a.name FROM rev a JOIN rev b ON a.rid = b.rid AND a.yr = '2024' AND b.yr = '2025' WHERE a.rev > 0 ORDER BY (b.rev - a.rev) / a.rev ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2024' AND CAST(substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 12

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND r.name = 'Tabuk' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' AND CAST(substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 12

WITH h2 AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, substr(o.order_date,1,4) AS yr, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) AS line_rev FROM regions r JOIN cities ci ON ci.region_id = r.id JOIN customers c ON c.city_id = ci.id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') AND CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) >= 7), agg AS (SELECT region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2024' THEN line_rev ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2025' THEN line_rev ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM h2 GROUP BY region_id, region_name HAVING rev_2024 > 0) SELECT region_name FROM agg ORDER BY (rev_2025 - rev_2024) / rev_2024 ASC, region_name LIMIT 1

WITH rev AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2025' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h25, SUM(CASE WHEN substr(o.order_date,1,4) = '2024' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) ELSE 0 END) AS h24 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND CAST(substr(o.order_date,6,2) AS INTEGER) >= 7 AND substr(o.order_date,1,4) IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY r.id) SELECT region_name FROM (SELECT region_name, (h25 - h24) * 1.0 / NULLIF(h24, 0) AS g FROM rev) ORDER BY (g IS NULL), g DESC, region_name LIMIT 1
